options.label: Redundant capability guard (Recommended)
options.description: Re-assert the same fund.full/admin capability inside each index() (e.g. abort_unless any-full-fund-or-admin). If the route middleware is ever removed, the controller still denies non-privileged users. Light, no new policy classes.

options.label: Full policy classes
options.description: Create viewAny policies for Goal/MatchingRule/Asset/ScheduledJob and register them. Most 'proper' but adds 4 policy classes + AuthServiceProvider wiring for global data.

options.label: Leave gate-only
options.description: Do query scoping only on the 11 scopable controllers (A+B+C); leave the 4 global ones relying solely on fund.full middleware as today. Smallest change.

## #85 implementation map

The 15 controllers split into **4 categories** by data model:

| # | Category | Scope method | Controllers |
|---|----------|-------------|-------------|
| **A** | Account-owned (`account_id`) | `scopeByAccountRelation` *(exists)* | accountGoals, accountMatchingRules, cashDeposits, accountReports, accountBalances, depositRequests |
| **B** | Direct `fund_id` | `scopeByFundColumn` *(exists)* | portfolios, fundReports |
| **C** | Via `portfolio → fund` | **new** `scopeByRelationFund` helper | portfolioAssets, tradePortfolios, tradePortfolioItems |
| **E** | Global / system (no fund or account column) | — *(semantically not fund-scopable)* | goals, matchingRules, assets, scheduledJobs |

**Categories A+B+C (11 controllers)** are clean: inject `AuthorizationService`, apply the scope to the `index()` query before `->get()` (preserving existing filters), mirroring Fund/Account/Transaction. Fund-admin of X then sees only X's rows; system-admin sees all.

**Category E (4 controllers)** is the judgment call: `goals` and `matchingRules` are shared *templates* (many-to-many via account_goals / hasMany), `assets`/`asset_prices` are reference data shared across funds, and `scheduledJobs` is system automation. None has a `fund_id`/`account_id` to scope on. Fund-scoping them would be wrong, so defense-in-depth has to take a different form.
